body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Philips presented its sound dock 'SBD7500' during Digital Experience at CES 2010, which combines sleek design and portability with superb sound quality.

A 2010 CES Innovation Honoree for Design, the iPhone/iPod Speaker Dock is designed to fit easily into a briefcase or laptop bag. It features exclusive wOOx technology plus Dynamic Bass boost for full rich sound, along with a battery that lasts up to 8 hours.
